driver: arcroad (one driver, one car, phone GPS at 1 Hz)
method: pipeline/groundtruth.py (pairing rule as amended 2 Nov 2026; loop rule, docs/PREREG-loop-rule.md), pipeline/fieldscore.py, pipeline/evidence.py

not_scored.why: A to B tried several times in the evening: each run either passed one end just outside the 10 m reach or the recording stopped before B; not scored

limitations: Evening drive on a Saturday, recorded in several files. Fixes worse than 20 m were dropped before scoring.

S11 B to A is read by the loop rule (A and B are 35.1 m apart). The loop closes on the last fix of one file; the day's files are joined before scoring, as on every field day, and the next file confirms the car did not come closer. The turnaround was made at a public junction (driver's confirmation).
A shortcut through a fuel station forecourt near S11 was also recorded. It is not a public road, so it is not scored; it is kept as a field observation.
